title: Send reminder emails for overdue loans
description:
Members keep forgetting to return their books. We want to remind them by email.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `node src/cli.js send-reminders` sends one reminder email for every overdue loan, through the mailer in `src/mailer.js`
- [ ] The email goes to the member's address and names the book title, the due date and the fine so far
- [ ] A loan gets at most one reminder per 7 days, so running the command daily doesn't spam anyone (remember when the last reminder was sent on the loan)
- [ ] The command prints how many reminders it sent
- [ ] Suspended members get reminders too
